summary_en: This Phase 1/2 trial is testing AAVAnc80-antiVEGF, a gene therapy, in adults with unilateral vestibular schwannoma. Each participant gets one dose into the inner ear of the study ear, using the Akouos Delivery Device, at one of three dose levels. The trial measures safety and tolerability, and it also evaluates how well the delivery device works.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1/2 evalúa AAVAnc80-antiVEGF, una terapia génica, en adultos con schwannoma vestibular en un solo oído. Cada participante recibe una sola dosis en el oído del estudio, usando el Akouos Delivery Device, en uno de tres niveles de dosis. El ensayo mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, y también evalúa qué tan bien funciona el dispositivo de administración.
who_for: Unilateral, progressive vestibular schwannoma in one ear
Profound hearing loss in the affected ear
Able and willing to follow trial requirements, including a separate long-term follow-up study
not_for: Prior diagnosis of NF2 or bilateral vestibular schwannoma
Prior surgery or radiation therapy for vestibular schwannoma
History consistent with endolymphatic hydrops in the affected ear
Profound hearing loss in the unaffected ear
Investigational drug trial within six months before Day 0, or any prior gene therapy trial
